body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #4, company drawn at random from pharma/healthcare + IT services names in the Rs 1,000-20,000 cr band (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.4 (naive base rate 0.44) that: INDRAMEDCO price return from 23-Nov-2026 (Rs 355.85) to 30-Sep-2027 exceeds the Nifty 500 price return (23,748.15). Our reasoning: A binary legal overhang with a hostile government affidavit; no dated catalyst in our favour; but the stock is already 43% below its Nov-2025 high (Rs 622.8) and peers trade at ~48x. Naive base: share of small caps beating the index over ~10 months, skewed below 0.5 [EST, as in live deep dives #1 and #3]. Resolution: YES if INDRAMEDCO.NS close on 30-Sep-2027 / 355.85 > ^CRSLDX close on 30-Sep-2027 / 23,748.15; price return, last close on or before 30-Sep-2027. Source: Yahoo v8 daily closes (INDRAMEDCO.NS, ^CRSLDX); NSE bhavcopy. Resolve by 2027-09-30; score with Brier vs the base rate.
